findings.summary: roastingUpsert_ writes with getRange(1,1,out.length,width) but never grows the sheet grid. The Roasting tab is created with the default ~1000 rows and rows are never purged, so once the kept+batch rows exceed the grid, every post throws 'exceeds grid limits' and ingest stops permanently (the write is atomic, so no corruption, but no data lands).
findings.suggestion: Before the setValues, if out.length > sheet.getMaxRows(), call sheet.insertRowsAfter(sheet.getMaxRows(), out.length - sheet.getMaxRows()) (or sheet.setRowCount(out.length)). Add a test that seeds the mock sheet near its max rows and asserts a post still lands. Alternatively document a retention cap in docs/schema.md.
